principle: Use the February 2026 Manufacturing recruitment and its directly linked current-cycle notices. Later additional/general testing and Special EPS-TOPIK are separate evidence layers and must not overwrite the 13th Manufacturing route.

answers.question: Who is Kyrgyzstan's official EPS sending body?
answers.answer: The Center for Employment of Citizens Abroad (CEC) under the Ministry of Labour, Social Security and Migration.
answers.writeExactly: Use migrant.kg / the Center for Employment of Citizens Abroad as the official Kyrgyz sending-side channel.

answers.question: Is the February 2026 EPS-TOPIK route Manufacturing?
answers.answer: Yes. The official Kyrgyz notice explicitly states employment in Korea in the production/manufacturing sector.
answers.writeExactly: The February 2026 general EPS-TOPIK recruitment is Manufacturing; this local official sector label matches HRD Korea's 13th Point System city schedules.

answers.question: What was the official Manufacturing exam fee?
answers.writeExactly: Official February 2026 Manufacturing EPS-TOPIK fee: US$28 through the designated Eldik/RSK Bank payment channel.

answers.question: What files did online registration require?
answers.answer: Gmail address; recent white-background 3.5×4.5 cm JPG photo; passport JPG; image of the US$28 payment receipt.
answers.writeExactly: Prepare exactly the official registration files and keep the original payment receipt for test day.

answers.question: What was the HRD Korea test-announcement date?
answers.answer: 2026-03-30 for both Bishkek and Osh 13th Point System tracks.

answers.question: What was the Bishkek test period?
answers.writeExactly: Bishkek 13th Point System test period: 2026-04-10 through 2026-04-16.

answers.question: What was the Osh test period?
answers.writeExactly: Osh 13th Point System test period: 2026-04-18 through 2026-04-19.

answers.question: When was the second-stage Skills Test?
What Manufacturing-related evidence could add points?
answers.answer: Relevant diploma: 1 point; professional certificate: 1 point; verified Manufacturing work experience: 3 points.
answers.writeExactly: Only original documents directly related to Manufacturing qualify under the local notice.

answers.question: What did the 2026-06-08 post-selection notice require?
answers.answer: Police clearance, USD Demir Bank account, medical clearance, two 3.5×4.5 photos, color copies of foreign passport and ID passport.
answers.writeExactly: These are verified 13th-cycle post-selection documents; future cycles require a fresh current notice.

answers.question: What was the verified medical window for successful Manufacturing candidates?
answers.writeExactly: 13th-cycle medical window: 2026-06-09 through 2026-06-11. Do not reuse for later cycles.

answers.question: When was the full package accepted?
answers.writeExactly: 13th-cycle full-package submission: 2026-06-15 at the official Bishkek/Osh offices.

answers.question: How long are successful testers kept on the candidate roster?
answers.answer: Two years under the official Kyrgyz registration guidance.
answers.writeExactly: Successful testers enter the unified candidate roster for two years; this does not guarantee a contract.

answers.question: Can a private person or official influence employer selection?
answers.answer: No. The official Kyrgyz guidance says private persons, legal entities, government bodies and officials cannot influence document submission, test passage or contract selection.
answers.writeExactly: Never promise or sell influence over test passage, roster priority or employer selection.

answers.question: Can the later 2026 additional/general test overwrite the February 13th Manufacturing route?
answers.writeExactly: Keep the later additional/general round separate unless an official artifact explicitly links it to this same Manufacturing cycle.

answers.question: Can Special EPS-TOPIK facts overwrite Regular Manufacturing?
answers.writeExactly: The July/September 2026 Special EPS-TOPIK is a returning-worker route and remains separate.
